'''Kerko''' were quadrupedal predators used for protection. [[Esano's sister]] owned a pet kerko during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], her kerko was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] when the fallen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|attacked]] [[Esano]] and his guards.
